MSFT.rationale: Microsoft presents a high-quality franchise with elite fundamentals — 18.3% YoY revenue growth, 46.3% operating margins, 1.47x OCF/NI cash conversion, and a fortress balance sheet with ~$38B net cash. The valuation has compressed significantly: PE at 27.4x sits at the 13th percentile of its 1Y range despite accelerating earnings growth (+23.4% YoY EPS), representing a 31% multiple compression from 39.6x a year ago. Azure's 40% growth and $37B AI ARR provide genuine structural tailwinds. The stock trades below the S&P 500 forward multiple — unusual for a business of this quality and growth rate. Offsetting factors cap the score below +0.5: the $190B capex commitment raises ROIC questions, Copilot class-action litigation creates reputational overhang, and the earnings yield (3.7%) sits below the 10Y Treasury (4.54%), meaning continued growth execution is required. The Q4 FY2026 earnings on July 29 provide a credible near-term catalyst — consensus expects $4.21 EPS (+15.3% YoY) and the company has beaten estimates in each of the past four quarters. Smart-money accumulation (Ackman ~$2B, Grantham, Asness) at current levels adds conviction. Score reflects strong fundamentals and attractive valuation tempered by capex overhang and litigation risk.
